title: OpenCore_Distilled-but-Not-Private-Investigating-Model-Inversion-Attacks
summary: An open-core research framework accompanying a paper on model inversion attacks against knowledge-distilled IoT network intrusion detection systems, evaluating how much training data leaks from distilled student models. Its evaluation module imports SDV's SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality to score the statistical fidelity of reconstructed data against real IDS data.
